method: Coordinator handlers on a generation-scoped whatif.db ledger; integer cents
howCounted: Cut = 35% of each paid cell after this season, or 50% for a known restructured contract; claimed and final-year cuts cost $0. Sum exact cents, round half-up once, then snap once to $10,000. Buyout = mean of remaining paid cells times 60% / 75% / 90% for 2 / 3 / 4 years, then one snap; at most two per season. Future salaries carry today’s MFL annual salary through contract expiration; MFL does not report those years separately. The exports do not establish restructure history: seeded contracts assume 35%, not a proven unrestructured verdict. This season's used begins at the mirror total; the engine's ledger delta is applied without changing the original MFL adjustments. MFL adjustments remain literal adjustments, not proven dead cap. The whole modelled charge lands in the cut year; future seasons have no modelled dead cap. Buyouts here model offseason terms without asserting that today's window is open; offseason start is not held. No submission or plan is created. Separate contract-cell update time: not held by this mirror. Separate dead-cap update time: not held by this mirror.
